theorems.statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (F : Euclid n → Euclid P) (B : Set (Euclid n)) (L : NNReal), LipschitzWith L F → MeasurableSet B → InjOn F B → ∃ J : Euclid n → ℝ, Measurable J ∧ (∀ a, 0 ≤ J a ∧ J a ≤ (L : ℝ) ^ n) ∧ (∀ g : Euclid P → ℝ≥0∞, ∫⁻ y in F '' B, g y ∂μHE[n] = ∫⁻ x in B, ENNReal.ofReal (J x) * g (F x) ∂volume) ∧ ∀ (a : Euclid n) (S : Set (Euclid n)), μHE[n] (fderiv ℝ F a '' S) = ENNReal.ofReal (J a) * volume S
